i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load the handed-in goal and context (what you are resolving) and the starting questions, if any. Read the glossary and the topic's relevant code/docs. Record pass when loaded.

q1.title: <starting question: what capability is being added or changed?>
q1.kind: <fact = resolve by exploring code | decision = block on the counterpart, never self-answer>
q1.imperative: <frame from behavior first: what capability is being added/changed (present tense), concrete examples/use cases incl. edge cases, architecturally meaningful events, governing rules/constraints/assumptions. Type the question fact|decision: a fact you resolve from the code/docs (record the evidence); a decision you take to your counterpart (never self-answer). Ask one question at a time with a recommended answer; append follow-ups and new branches; skip questions overcome by earlier answers>

zc-consolidate.title: Consolidate behind the finish gate
zc-consolidate.imperative: Do NOT record this until joint understanding is reached. Write the interrogation record from templates/INTERROGATION_RECORD.template.json (each question typed fact|decision; each resolved decision carrying its human_answer; each resolved fact its code_evidence) and capture the counterpart's explicit sign-off. Run `python <skill-dir>/scripts/verify_interrogation.py <record>` — it MUST exit 0 (it refuses consolidation without the joint-understanding sign-off, and refuses any self-answered decision). Before consolidating, fill this item's postcondition command with the real record path you wrote it to -- record() now runs it and refuses `pass` if it fails. Record pass only after exit 0, then `consolidate`.

postconditions.statement: verify_interrogation.py exits 0 on the interrogation record -- refuses a self-answered decision or a consolidation with no joint-understanding sign-off
